extraction.by: claude-opus-5.5 (main agent, read from table image)

notes: All scores are in one table image on the blog; the values were read from the image (2160x4020 PNG) and the quote is the image alt text. Row labels and column headers are from the image. Metric names come from the methodology PDF where it names them (MCP Atlas and IFBench mean pass rate, DeepSearch QA F1); else "score". GDPval-AA is an Elo-style score. The quantization table image and the decode-speed chart are not eval scores and were skipped. Siren AgentDojo is a variant of AgentDojo (949 scenarios, adaptive attacker), so it is not the AgentDojo registry eval.
